text.p: Cascade Communications Corp, which provides frame relay and asynchronous transfer mode switching products, said on Sunday it expected its first quarter earnings would be between $0.14 and $0.15 per share, below analysts' estimates.
U.S. networking company Ascend Communications Inc also announced on Sunday it planned to acquire Cascade in a stock swap valued at about $3.7 billion.

Cascade, which plans to release full results on April 10 after financial markets shut, was not immediately available to comment. The forecast excluded a one-time charge associated with its acquisition of Sahara Networks Inc, it said.
It said based on current information, it expected to report first quarter revenues of about $90 million.
The First Call consensus estimate for the quarter was $0.22 per share. The quarter ended March 29.
Ascend declined to comment on Cascade's announcement.
